Legal

Privacy notice

This notice explains what information this website handles and who else is involved when you use it.

Last updated November 10, 2026

01

The short version

This website does not use advertising pixels or analytics trackers. It keeps two small preferences in your own browser, and it only connects you to other services (our online menu, YouTube, Google Maps) when you use them.

02

What stays in your browser

  • Age confirmation. When you confirm you are 21 or older, your browser remembers it so you are not asked on every page.
  • Shopping preference. If you choose “order ahead” or “shop in store”, your browser remembers that too.
  • Quick-action bar. If you hide it, your browser remembers that for the visit.

These preferences stay on your device. You can clear them at any time by clearing this site’s data in your browser.

03

Our online menu and orders

The menu on our shop pages, including the cart and checkout, is provided by our online ordering partner, Dutchie. When you browse the menu or place an order, the information you enter is handled by that service under its own terms and privacy policy, and is shared with us so we can prepare your order and check your ID at pickup.

04

Messages and the list

Our contact and “Join the List” forms open your own email app with your message addressed to info@thehighercompanyllc.com. We receive only what you choose to send, and use it to reply to you or, if you asked to join the list, to send you news from the shop. Ask us to stop at any time.

05

Video and maps

Our YouTube video and the Google map load only when you press play or ask for the map. From that moment, Google’s privacy policy applies to that content.

06

Children

This website is for adults 21 and older. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 21.

07

Contact

Questions about privacy: info@thehighercompanyllc.com, or The Higher Company LLC, 123 E Willow St, Syracuse, NY 13202.
